name: magnetic-button
title: Magnetic Button
description: The button follows your pointer and springs back into place.
useCases: On a studio homepage, a visitor presses “View portfolio.” The app opens the collection through onClick.
At the end of a presentation, a “Try the demo” button responds to the approaching pointer and opens the demo when pressed.
task: The button follows your pointer and springs back into place.
behavior: Set the button label through children. Pass the action to onClick from a client component.
